The '''Technical Analysis division''' was a branch of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[New Republic Intelligence Service|Intelligence Service]]. Following the [[Corellian Crisis]], the Technical Analysis division prepared a report on the [[hyperwave inertial momentum sustainer]] for [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Kursk Mal'ia]].<ref name="CTD" />
